summary: V50.z400 Corporate Gym unified structure — Backend 7/7 pytest PASS. GET /api/cgym/areas returns obiezioni, winwin, trattativa keys. WinWin has exactly 8 blocks starting with '1 · Telefonata di presa appuntamento'. POST /cgym/live/start on winwin → opening 'Pronto?', on obiezioni → 'Prego, si accomodi. Mi dica.' (obiezioni has 3 blocks). Turn + finish work end-to-end with LLM. Materials POST + GET raw=1 returns bytes with Content-Disposition inline; raw=1&download=1 returns attachment; no raw returns JSON {name,mime,data_base64}; unauthenticated raw returns 401. Frontend PDF viewer route verified on web (title, close button, placeholder text 'Anteprima disponibile nell app'). Frontend area tiles / legacy redirects / manual sheet / live-8-blocks UI tests could NOT be executed by the agent because the web preview auth flow doesn't persist the token via localStorage injection — the /corporate-gym page rendered the sessions view but the CgymAreasGrid did not mount (401 loop on subsequent /api calls). Main agent should self-test these UI flows in-app or provide a UI-level login path.
action_items: Main agent to self-verify (or via a UI-authenticated Playwright script) the following frontend flows, since agent couldn't inject auth into Expo web storage: (1) /corporate-gym shows tiles cgym-area-obiezioni/winwin/trattativa; (2) tap obiezioni → /corporate-gym/area/<id> shows cgym-live-start, cgym-manual-btn-obiezioni, cgym-analyze-recording, cgym-area-ratings, blocks list, materials section; (3) same for winwin tile with cgym-manual-btn-winwin + 8 blocks listed; (4) trattativa tile has NO manual button; (5) /corporate-gym/obiezioni and /corporate-gym/win-win redirect to /corporate-gym/area/<id>; (6) tap cgym-manual-btn-obiezioni opens cgym-manual-sheet-obiezioni without crash; (7) /corporate-gym/live?area=<winwin>&level=base shows 'Blocco 1/8 · 1 · Telefonata…' header.
